Devilled eggs, smoked salmon on rye and cocktail franks in a sticky glaze, served on silver trays like a 1940s supper club.

Slow-caramelised onion folded through sour cream and cream cheese with chives and Worcestershire, with crinkle-cut chips and pretzels for scooping. Slice 3 brown onions thinly and cook in 30g butter over low heat for 40 minutes until deep brown and jammy, then cool and chop. Beat 250g sour cream with 100g cream cheese, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce and salt, then fold in the onion and chopped chives. Chill 30 minutes. Serve with a 175g bag crinkle-cut chips and 150g pretzels.
M: Steamed pastrami, mustard and melted Swiss on rye, dill pickle on the side

A hot pastrami sandwich: pastrami steamed, piled on rye with mustard and Swiss, grilled until the cheese melts. Steam 400g pastrami for 10 minutes until glossy. Pile onto 8 slices rye with mustard and 4 slices Swiss cheese. Grill until the cheese melts. Serve each with a dill pickle on the side.
1947 Los Angeles, the Red Car still running

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick over creamy mash with buttered green beans and gravy. Mix 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Press into a loaf tin and spread with 100ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar. Bake at 180C for 60 minutes and rest. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Steam 300g green beans. Serve with gravy.
W: "Just drawn that way" red velvet cake
Red velvet layers with cream cheese frosting and a glossy red icing on top

Red velvet cake baked at 175C, layered with cream cheese frosting, a glossy red glaze on top. Beat 125g butter and 250g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Layer with cream cheese frosting and pour a glossy red icing over the top.
K: Eddie's ginger beer on the rocks
Ginger beer over a big ice block with lime and a drop of vanilla, no alcohol

Fiery ginger beer over a big ice block with fresh lime and a dash of vanilla, poured into heavy tumblers like a detective's nightcap. Put one large ice block in each of 4 heavy tumblers. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 2 drops vanilla extract. Top each with 200ml cold ginger beer, poured slowly so it keeps its fizz. Stir once and add a lime wheel. Serve at the desk, with a fedora if you have one.

s.note: Baby carrots roasted with honey, cumin and thyme, feta and yogurt dip
s.how: Toss 2 bunches baby carrots with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp cumin, thyme and oil. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until caramelised. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt for the dip.
